Ashland Cycle Sport Wednesday Night MTB Ride

Ashland, OR · Downtown · Mountain bike

Ashland Cycle Sport Wednesday Night MTB Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Ashland, OR. It rolls every Wednesday at 5:30 pm from Ashland Cycle Sport. Pace: moderate to hard, with steep climbs and descents.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: moderate to hard, with steep climbs and descents.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Ashland Cycle Sport Wednesday Night MTB Ride group ride

A Wednesday evening shop mountain bike ride on the Ashland trails. Routes run an hour to an hour and a half and include real climbing. Helmets and a working bike are required; lights from October through March.
